reviewed_by: Claude: Nebula-wide Butler check covers every Act project
reason: The Nebula-wide scheduled Butler check runs on the execution worker of the Act project hosting it, whose SQL scope showed only that project, so the check saw one Act project per run. execution_scope adds global_check_reads(): observer reads allowed on a non-home worker only inside it, used only by ButlerGlobalActions reads and the check's prompt roster; row locks and writes stay fenced to the host project. ButlerGlobalActions wraps its reads in it, names the target's Watch/Steer authority when refusing, and sends changes to a non-host project as butler.action/v1 commands (initiator background, case_id, target authority_revision) through an execution worker's RemoteButlerActions (control_assistant_work.global_butler_actions, set in execution_worker for non-home leases); recovery goals, project resume and child projects stay host-only. runtime_butler_actions: the host admits a background action only from the sender's live lease while its case is an investigating butler.global_periodic_check in the sender's project and the target differs; results read back only under that case; the target runs it only under its own current Act authority at the read revision, Work enabled, no hold, never a hold operation. butler_recovery: the global packet lists every Act project with open main goals (IDs, title, status, Work stage), capped and marked truncated, and the instructions ask the summary to cover each. Review fixes: refusals for non-visible projects are one generic message (no name or authority, privacy scope checked first); the roster's runtime_local follows the harness account actually chosen by _scheduled_harness_profile; background idempotency keys include the target project; workers enable remote background changes only when the host advertises butler_background_actions (runtime_host_services; older hosts get the 'after its next update' refusal). Per-project checks are unchanged. Docs: butler-home-worker and butler-proactive-recovery (not product-knowledge sources; the rebuild left the index unchanged). Python selects the new suite, the suites of edited modules, and the global/periodic tests of test_butler_capabilities and test_butler_recovery.
exclusions: tests/v3/test_butler_capabilities.py::test_scheduled_butler_can_edit_all_assistant_settings and tests/v3/test_butler_recovery.py::test_act_switches_worker_to_provider_and_queues_only_the_parent fail on unmodified main (operator-listed known failures), so those two files are selected only by their global and periodic node ids. harnesses.py, runtime_platform.py and execution_kernel.py are untouched. No UI change. No live Core or host contact. PostgreSQL variants skip without NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL. No full-suite approval.
